rules.sentence: Diagnosis of cyanosis is based on a careful history, a thorough physical examination, and the use of ancillary studies.
If a congenital heart condition is suspected, transthoracic and transesophageal echocardiography can be used to evaluate the cardiovascular system.
To assess blood flow and shunting, cardiac Doppler is a very important diagnostic tool.
Other tests include cardiac catheterization, CT scan, and MRI of the heart[9].
Pulmonary causes of cyanosis like pneumonia, pleural effusion, and pulmonary embolism can best be evaluated by using imaging studies like X-Ray, CT Scan, and ultrasound of the chest.
